title: Gith Shard
summary: Insert the Gith Shard into the Barrier Disruptor beside the north archway in the Captain’s Quarters to reach the Inquisitor’s Chamber.

fields.Acquisition: Pickpocket Kith’rak Therezzyn or loot her body. If you offer to show her the artefact, she opens the barrier herself.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
